source: Sonia's public LinkedIn profile, copied manually by the candidate
name: Sonia
headline: Fractional CMO | Crafting Brands People Can Feel | Human Messaging, Clear Strategy & Meaningful Growth | Guiding Teams & Founders to Think Better
quotes: I notice what others don't. The gaps, the confusion, the unspoken story, and I help make sense of it.
I don't believe in complicating things.

nodes.title: Noticing the gaps
nodes.text: In her words: she notices the gaps, the confusion and the unspoken story, and helps make sense of it.

nodes.title: The whole picture
nodes.text: She says her strength is seeing how brand affects revenue, how messaging affects conversion, how operations affect execution, and how people affect everything.

nodes.title: Building teams
nodes.text: At Appirio she built the Jaipur Marketing Center with 15 team members. At Lasersec she led a team of 20+ marketing professionals.

nodes.title: Driving demand
nodes.text: Her profile states that at ShowMeLeads (2014) demand generation work drove 1,200 new opportunities and 100 closed deals.

nodes.title: Sharing openly
nodes.text: She offers free consultancy to help startups become modern marketers, and published research on free social media tools for small businesses and startups.

nodes.title: Today
nodes.text: Fractional CMO and advisor. Her profile lists CMO at i-SmokeStack (since 2020) and a fractional CMO role at Datt Mediproducts (since 2020).

nodes.title: Roots
nodes.text: B.E. in Electronics & Telecommunication (2002-2006), then marketing and sales management at Symbiosis (2007-2009) and an Executive MBA in Marketing at IIM Bangalore (2007-2008). Early marketing roles at Bosch and FARO.

notes: The brief calls her the founder, but her LinkedIn lists her as Fractional CMO and as CMO at i-SmokeStack. Use LinkedIn wording on the page.
HubSpot certifications on her profile are marked expired. Do not present them as current.
The Appirio company-value growth figure on her profile is a placeholder ($X to $5X). Do not use it as a number.
